title: PublicWorkspaceResponse
description: Response shape for GET /public/{slug} (Spec §4.8 / §11, Plan §18.3 / §18.4). Allow-list contract: every field listed here is intentionally public; anything not listed is considered private and MUST NOT appear in the response.

name.description: Workspace name as set by the owner.

stages.description: Exactly the four finalised stages in pipeline order: spec, plan, harness, tasks.

content.description: Finalised stage content. For the harness stage, this is the parsed harness summary, not the full directory tree.

coverage_summary.description: Harness coverage figure surfaced from the latest EvalResult. Null if the harness stage has no eval.

eval_summary.description: Optional aggregate eval scores rendered as social proof on the public view.

shared_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent enable/rotate. Used as the cache key bumper.

$comment: SECURITY: this schema is the contract for what /public/{slug} may reveal. The following fields MUST NOT appear under any circumstance: user_id, email, google_id, credit balances, raw workspace id, problem_statement (unless inside the spec stage content), public_share_slug, clarification_qa, internal eval breakdown beyond what is listed here. Any addition to this schema is a privacy review item.
